skills.name: authoring-skills
skills.description: Author a new agent skill or improve an existing one - write the SKILL.md frontmatter and description, structure the body, and fix skills that under- or over-trigger. Use when asked to create/write a skill, make a SKILL.md, improve/refactor a skill, or fix a skill's description.

skills.name: commit-messages
skills.description: Use when creating git commits, writing commit messages, or when about to run git commit -- enforces structured commit message format with imperative mood, capitalized subjects, 72-char wrapping, and atomic commits

skills.name: gitlab-babysit-mr
skills.description: Monitor a GitLab MR's pipeline until green. Classifies failures (flaky, master-broken, lint, coverage, real), retries jobs where appropriate, makes light-touch auto-fixes, and posts findings as an MR comment.

skills.name: gitlab-clickhouse
skills.description: Inspect GitLab local ClickHouse tables, schemas, ingestion paths, and data patterns. Use for CH table questions, DESCRIBE TABLE, schema and source-of-truth checks under db/click_house, ingestion debugging, and investigating aggregates, distributions, outliers, or anomalous ClickHouse data in a GitLab GDK environment.

skills.name: gitlab-mr-description
skills.description: Write or update a GitLab MR description. Reads the branch diff, drafts structured markdown using GitLab's standard sections, and applies conventions for feature flags, database queries, and local testing matrices. Use when opening a new MR or refreshing an existing description.

skills.name: gitlab-pipeline-watch
skills.description: Watch GitLab MR pipelines and react to state changes

skills.name: gitlab-psql
skills.description: Inspect GitLab GDK PostgreSQL test and development databases with gdk psql. Use for Postgres schema checks, table and index inspection, read-only SQL queries, migration verification, and investigating GitLab application data in local test or development databases.

skills.name: glab
skills.description: GitLab workflow automation using glab CLI

skills.name: glab-glql
skills.description: Execute GLQL queries against GitLab projects and groups using glab CLI

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Compact the current session into a handoff document so a fresh agent can continue the work. Use when the user says hand off, wrap up, save context, continue later, pick this up in a new session, running low on context, or context is getting long.

skills.name: mr-adversarial-review
skills.description: Use when running a critical, skeptical pass over a GitLab MR — either as the author before requesting human review, or as a reviewer wanting a structured first cut — produces a severity-bucketed findings report (High / Medium / Low / Done well) and posts it as a single comment on the MR.

skills.name: mr-review
skills.description: Review a GitLab merge request - read diffs, analyze changes, present findings, and optionally post comments on the MR

skills.name: opencode-refine
skills.description: Iteratively test and refine prompts, skills, and agent configurations using opencode run

skills.name: playwright-cli
skills.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

skills.name: pushify
skills.description: Run pre-push lefthook checks and iteratively fix failures (up to 3 iterations, then escalate). Invoke when: (a) about to push and wanting hooks to pass cleanly, (b) `git push` has just failed on a pre-push hook and the failure needs to be driven to resolution, or (c) preparing a clean working tree without pushing — e.g. before opening a Draft MR for early review.

skills.name: run-in-tmux-pane
skills.description: Run commands in a temporary tmux pane with full interactive zsh environment (login shell, shims, PATH, aliases, TTY).

skills.name: self-service-performance-testing
skills.description: Help engineers write performance tests that detect regressions, using k6 for load testing, sitespeed.io for frontend Core Web Vitals, rspec-benchmark for unit-level perf assertions, and Ruby profilers (Stackprof, memory_profiler, derailed_benchmarks, etc.) for investigating slow code paths. Use when the user is adding or changing API endpoints, database queries, critical paths, or frontend pages and needs to decide whether to write a performance test, what kind, or how to integrate it into CI. Also activate when the user mentions load testing, stress testing, response times, benchmarking, performance budgets, CPT, component performance testing, MR pipeline performance testing, profiling slow Ruby code, memory bloat, or wants to run tests against staging - this skill enforces shared infrastructure safety rules. Does not cover APM or debugging production incidents.

skills.name: stack-changes
skills.description: Splits a large local change (uncommitted or committed) into a stacked-MR chain. Use when the user asks to split an MR they find too big to review, wants stacked diffs, has sprawling AI-mode work to publish, or types /stack-changes.

skills.name: write-large-file
skills.description: Write large files reliably using chunked bash append (>> heredoc)
